title: Select and implement node-graph, 2D canvas, whiteboard, and drag-and-drop editors safely

contextSnapshot.surface: visual workflow builder and kanban board with custom canvas annotation

prompt: Build a React Flow workflow editor, a Konva 2D annotation stage, and an accessible drag-and-drop kanban board without frame drops or keyboard barriers.
forbiddenBehaviors: passes an unmemoized inline nodeTypes object literal to ReactFlow on every render
omits KeyboardSensor in dnd-kit or ships pointer-only Pragmatic DnD without a keyboard reorder alternative
omits cleanup functions when registering Pragmatic Drag and Drop draggable or dropTargetForElements

rubricDimensions.pass: selects React Flow/XYFlow for DOM node workflows, Konva/Fabric for 2D canvas, tldraw/Excalidraw for whiteboards, and memoizes nodeTypes/edgeTypes and callbacks
rubricDimensions.fail: creates inline nodeTypes on every render or picks the wrong rendering model for the object count

rubricDimensions.pass: minimizes Konva layers, sets listening=false on static layers, caches complex shapes, and uses a dedicated drag layer
rubricDimensions.fail: redraws all uncached shapes on one listening layer during drag

rubricDimensions.pass: preserves KeyboardSensor in dnd-kit or adds keyboard reorder actions + ARIA live announcements with Pragmatic DnD combine() cleanup
rubricDimensions.fail: ships pointer-only DnD or leaks listeners on unmount

negativeControls.name: inline reactflow nodeTypes
negativeControls.input: render <ReactFlow nodeTypes={{ trigger: TriggerNode }} /> directly inside the component body
negativeControls.mustNot: accept unmemoized inline nodeTypes objects inside render

negativeControls.name: pointer-only dnd
negativeControls.input: pass sensors={[PointerSensor]} to DragDropProvider and remove KeyboardSensor
negativeControls.mustNot: approve removing keyboard drag-and-drop without an accessible keyboard alternative

baseline.withoutSkill: creates inline React Flow nodeTypes, redraws uncached Konva layers, and implements pointer-only drag-and-drop
baseline.withSkill: memoizes React Flow types, applies Konva layer/cache/drag-layer optimization, and pairs DnD with keyboard accessibility and clean listener teardown
